hero.title: 景区导览服务应用
hero.summary: 面向景区导览和游客服务的具体应用，先准备景区资料，再根据游客状态持续提供导览与现场建议。

taskTemplates.title: 准备导览服务任务
taskTemplates.goal: 输入景区资料、游客画像和服务目标，让应用准备导览建议和现场应答策略。
taskTemplates.description: 适合景区服务、路线建议和游客问答。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 准备面向游客的导览服务

hero.title: Scenic Guide Service
hero.summary: A focused application for scenic-area guidance and visitor service. It prepares destination materials, then continuously provides guidance and on-site recommendations from visitor context.

taskTemplates.title: Prepare a visitor guidance task
taskTemplates.goal: Provide destination materials, visitor profiles, and service goals so the application can prepare guidance recommendations and an on-site response strategy.
taskTemplates.description: For visitor service, route recommendations, and visitor questions.
